title: 小米运动健康 3.57.0 第一方 RN 页面与可迁移 UI 规格
basis: Shipped APK static JavaScript AST and source inspection; no bundle execution or device observation.
unitRules: RN StyleSheet numeric dimensions are logical units, not measured physical pixels.
NativeBase props may resolve numeric keys through space/sizes/radii. A missing key falls back to the original value. Explicit px strings bypass numeric token lookup.
NativeBase default tokens describe the shipped resolver, not proof every component is used. Component facts below cite actual page/module calls.
Observed here means observed in shipped code. Runtime visibility and visual fidelity remain unverified.

fontFamilies.scope: Explicitly used by large title and selected components; bulk NativeBase Text retains platform family unless overridden. Not a universal MiSans font rule.

frame.header: Large title + add menu icon, omitted in basicMode
frame.tabs: Server topTabs map type→Sport/Plan/Course/Weight; fallback is one Sport tab without label
frame.body: Lazy visited pages in animated PagerView; exception boundary per tab

ordered: SportWay if route list nonempty or aiOpen

interactions.behavior: Set page; interpolate underline/label opacity from pager position+offset; click ignored while pager non-idle; visited tabs stay mounted
Anchored menu: add device or scan QR; closes first, checks login, then native route; iOS adds 200 ms wait
Only wired when logged in; syncDeviceAll, refresh plan ability/device capability and current feed; finally clears refreshing
Silent update current feed with cached promise state; CN+login requests location with pre-request modal
Data card opens native training index page; empty card routes training goal/empty flow; multiple cards horizontal, one card full width

states.behavior: SportHome suspense fallback empty fragment; Plan/Course tabs have their own loader, not universal skeleton
Unknown component types filtered; optional routes/empty indicators omitted

frame.header: Message icon (CN visibility gate) + add menu; uses TabViewContainer

interactions.behavior: Logged in opens native UserIndicatorsActivity; logged out opens login page. NnLoginUserProfile also calls showLoginPage once on mount
Shared login guard shows LoginModal before invoking action when logged out
Leading-only throttle 300 ms; route/help actions depend on login; logout still permits App settings/System permission/About
CN only except AndroidOut; unread dot 6×6, radius3; login guard then MessageHome; updates on appearance and unread event

states.behavior: Empty fragment while region/login fetch is pending
Render logout branch for region rather than generic error screen

pages.excludedLegacy: mi-379 Mine is independently registered; not used as proof of MineTab composition.

structure: Top nav: back + market/my tabs + search
Market list: banner/quick access/3-column curated pools/2-column recommendation feed
Top back + search (home/category); own title/actions in My
Three visited lazy pages: home / category aggregation / my watch faces
variants.homeList: Recommendation groups 3 watch faces per logical row with interleaved banners; other tabs use 3 columns

interactions.behavior: Routes by current device model/capability; native or RN detail variants
RefreshControl; conditional load more at threshold .2; no footer loading if offline
V4 queues exclusive offer, regular popup and transformer popup; persists dismissal flag; no simultaneous stack
Connection/stream-idle/network/version/capability checks; one install stream; toast or dialog for busy/disconnect/battery/storage/version failure

states.behavior: Only show empty image+text when banners, shortcuts and list are all empty
Progress separates stages; failure returns idle and shows specific feedback

interactionPatterns.scope: Medal item; optional tactile pattern for similar object cards
Only initially empty→newly available training indicators

transferableRules.rule: Separate shell, components, state machines and domain data
transferableRules.apply: Swap health-specific text/data/routes while retaining paddings, typography, rounded surfaces, feedback, loading and navigation semantics.

transferableRules.rule: Use a calm neutral canvas and rounded solid surfaces
transferableRules.apply: Light page #F6F7F9 + white cards; dark page #000000 + #191919 cards; orange for primary active/action, neutral text alpha for hierarchy.
transferableRules.authority: derived from cited appTheme and card calls

transferableRules.rule: Use a small hierarchy instead of a new type scale on every page
transferableRules.apply: Large 32 light page title; 20 medium profile/detail title; 17 section title; 16 row/main body; 14 secondary; 12 metadata. Preserve local overrides.
Top segmented sections may swipe with continuous underline; distinct bottom sections switch without swipe in Dial V4; detail pages push from right.
Design pending/refreshing/loaded/empty/partial/offline/unauthenticated/permission-denied/error/busy/success for each reusable component; instantiate only states applicable to the new business.
transferableRules.authority: reconstruction recommendation grounded in observed state branches

transferableRules.rule: Use motion to acknowledge input or explain layout change
transferableRules.apply: Retain observed 100 ms press, 300 ms popup and 500 ms content reveal as separate patterns, not one universal animation. Do not animate every card.

transferableRules.rule: Retain component silhouette during fetch where code does
transferableRules.apply: Profile has blank structured fallback, watch-face market has shape-specific skeletons; optional empty sections disappear. Do not force one loading treatment everywhere.

transferableRules.rule: Preserve region/login/device configuration as composition gates
transferableRules.apply: Treat optional modules as configuration; keep stable shell/order without hardcoding one observed business account.

unknowns: No Android runtime screenshot or video was captured. Real viewport, installed fonts, rasterized line metrics and perceived easing are unmeasured.
Remote top tabs, operations banners, watchface feed, region/account/device configuration and hot-updated bundles may change visible composition.
Only shipped RN source targets and conditional logic are established. Native screen implementation must be joined to native agent evidence.
The common bundle includes third-party UI packages. Their mere export/presence is not proof of application usage.
No claim of all page/state/animation coverage. Focus is SportHome, MineTab and DialMarket with reusable patterns.

runtimeCrosscheckReference.scope: MineTab empty heading and QuickActions dual baseline
runtimeCrosscheckReference.correction: Builtin 4 entries versus updated 5 entries + removed inner horizontal padding are verified source-version changes, not theme-driven count rules.
